content: I've seen you before, haven't I?
Well, you may have. I've been here once or twice, for a walk in this quiet park. Do you live near here?
Yes. I live in one of those flats over there. What about you?
Oh, I'm staying with a family down near the station.
Well...er...I'm here to improve my English. I'm from Greece, you see.
I didn't think you were English, but your English is very good.
